lean.statement: theorem lisse_finite_level_etale_model_comparison (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (U : Y.ProEt) (n : ℕ) (N : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n)))) (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n))) (D : DerivedCategory (Sheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)))) (hDbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D)) (hDlisse : ∀ q : ℤ, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D)) (hmodels : ∃ T : Sieve U, T ∈ ProEt.topology Y U ∧ ∀ (W : Y.ProEt) (w : W ⟶ U), T w → Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj E ≅ (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N)) : Nonempty ((lisseTowerFixedRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d n).obj ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)) U.left).mapDerivedCategory.obj D) ≅ (adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N)
